faq.q: How far ahead should I book a DJ?
faq.a: As early as you can — weekends and holidays fill up fast. Send your date on WhatsApp and we will confirm availability.

faq.q: Can I hire gadgets without a DJ?
faq.a: Yes. Gear can be hired on its own for your event, and our team can help with delivery and setup.

faq.q: How do I book the recording studio?
faq.a: Send us a message with your preferred date and what you would like to record. Sessions are by appointment.
We are based at Seguku Katale, Wankulukuku Road, Kampala, and travel for events. Tell us your venue and we will confirm.
Yes — the DJ Academy runs hands-on training from the basics to performing live.

faq.q: What is included in a package?
faq.a: Packages combine a DJ with the sound, microphones and lighting that suit your venue and guest count. We confirm exactly what is included, in writing, in your quote.
Yes. Pick a DJ from the Book a DJ section, or tell us the style you want and we will suggest one.

faq.q: Can you provide sound and lighting as well as a DJ?
faq.a: Yes. Controllers, mixers, PA speakers, microphones and stage lighting are available through DJ Gadget Hire, on their own or as part of a package.

faq.q: How do I get a quote?
faq.a: Use the booking form or message us on WhatsApp with your date, venue and type of event. We reply with availability and clear pricing.

faq.q: What kinds of events do you cover?
faq.a: Weddings, club and lounge nights, corporate events, private parties, school and campus events, and content shoots.

modules.title: Introduction
modules.desc: Meet the booth. What a working DJ actually does, the roles inside a DJ setup, how the industry pays, and the mindset that separates a hobbyist from a booked professional.

modules.title: Setting up DJ equipment
modules.desc: Controllers, CDJs, mixers, monitors, headphones and cables, wired correctly and safely. Gain staging, booth balancing and fast set-up in an unfamiliar venue.

modules.title: The structure of music
modules.desc: Beats, bars, phrases and eight-counts. Song anatomy, BPM counting, key awareness and how intros, breakdowns and drops tell you when to move.

modules.title: Beat matching & sync
modules.desc: Train your ear first, then master the tools: manual pitch riding, cue-point drops, waveform reading and when to trust sync.

modules.title: Audio mixing
modules.desc: EQ blending, fader and crossfader technique, loops, hot cues and effects for seamless transitions that keep the floor locked in.

modules.title: Video mixing
modules.desc: Run visuals alongside your audio set: video cueing, clip libraries, transitions, effect layers and clean output to LED walls and screens.

modules.title: Scratching
modules.desc: Baby scratch, chirp, transform and flare. Hand coordination, timing drills and using scratches as musical accents.

modules.title: DJ routine
modules.desc: Build and rehearse a full performance set: energy mapping, reading the crowd, mic work, requests, stage presence and closing a room.

modules.title: Best DJ equipment tips & advice
modules.desc: What to buy first, what to avoid, gear maintenance, backup planning, pricing your bookings and building your brand.
